summary: Phishing Simulator v2 (radar hub, investigation console, run engine, ₹199 gating, landing section) tested end-to-end. Backend: new suite test_phish_console.py (12 tests) + legacy test_phishing_sim.py = 48/48 pass. Frontend: hub radar (blips every 2s, legend 4 groups, counters, feed ≤4, match card Open/Unlock + guide), mobile 390px strip (no SVG, no horizontal overflow), unlock box ₹199 with disabled pay + 'Payments open soon' for student / hidden for admin, type page checklist/mistakes/KQL↔Splunk toggle, case console (SLA countdown, hints −5/−10, ATT&CK tags, stepper incl. keyboard Enter/Space, Report phishing → Reported, link hover real URL, pin dialog with 7 options incl. distractors, keyboard-Enter pin, edit/unpin, SPF/DKIM/DMARC chips, domain mismatch x3, lookalike '0' highlight, sandbox detonate progress → seeded malicious result, IOC box, OSINT link, respond effects green/red, summary min-20 gate, full debrief + playbook link + retry resets to 10:00/100), landing-phish directly after landing-sops with '3 free cases · all 28 for ₹199', OSINT header analyzer + admin Manage tab regression all working. Two real defects found (hop order on ph-spear-2, pins not persisted on reload) plus minor items.

minor.issue: hdr() writes Received lines oldest-first, but parse_headers() reverses them (RFC newest-on-top assumption). Result: the 'Received hops (oldest first)' timeline shows relay.hostingco.test (16:05:03) before vps-77.hostingco.test (16:05:01) — reversed, and originating hop is wrong. Fix: in phish_cases2.hdr build rec from reversed(hops) so the newest Received is on top (affects only multi-hop cases; currently ph-spear-2).

headers[].iocs (parse_headers output) returns header-extracted IPs/domains (e.g. ph-email-1: 185.234.219.12, mailer-svc.top, micros0ft-securemail.com = 3 of 4 graded IOCs). UI doesn't render it, but answers are in the payload. Strip 'iocs' (and maybe 'warnings') from public_case headers if IOCs must stay server-side.
Returns 503 'Razorpay is not configured yet' (not 'Invalid plan') — product is recognised; expected in preview.

ui_bugs.issue: Pins, IOC text, verdict and summary are client-only. Reloading the page resumes the server run (SLA, hints, reported, actions persist) but all pins are lost, while the timeline still lists the earlier 'Pinned …' events → debrief timeline says items were pinned that aren't scored (evidence 8/30). Persist pins (e.g. via event payload or a run.pins field) or reset timeline consistently.
done array is [seen[1], pins>0||seen[2], verdict, actions, false] — pinning on Evidence marks 'Analyze' green before it's opened. Minor semantic mismatch.

issues: Glass grid uses items-center: when radar-match-card opens, the right column grows and the radar scope jumps down ~60px; use items-start to avoid layout shift.
Email From/Date values break mid-word (no-re|ply@…, +05|30) — consider break-all only for addresses or stacking label/value.

action_items: Reverse hop order in phish_cases2.hdr() (newest Received first) so ph-spear-2 hop timeline is correct
Persist pins (and optionally IOCs/verdict draft) on the run so reload/resume doesn't silently drop evidence
Remove headers[].iocs from public_case payload to keep graded IOCs server-side
Optional: items-start on radar grid; stepper done logic for Analyze
critical_code_review_comments: routes_phish_run.restart marks the old run submitted+abandoned even if it was already submitted (filter has submitted:False so OK) — fine.

state(): response penalty in max_score uses round(20*wrong/right); final scoring uses pick_score (right-wrong)/right — consistent enough but HUD 'max score' doesn't reflect skipped correct actions (by design).
Radar useMemo(() => types, [types]) is a no-op; if parent re-creates d.types the interval restarts — currently stable.
Hints for cases without explicit hints auto-generate 'Key finding: <correct red flag>' — intended trade-off for −15.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; 1 medium state-persistence bug, 1 data-order bug)

seed_data_creation: No seed data. Test runs/attempts created for student (ph-email-1) and admin (ph-email-2, ph-smishing-2, ph-calendar-2, ph-spear-2 run) with TEST_ summaries. Student phish grant was set true then reverted to false (verified 403 again).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use tests/test_phish_console.py (run engine, gating with grant+revert, benign scoring, leak check). Student has an open ph-email-1 run that is reused (fresh_run helper restarts if hints/actions exist). Payments unconfigured in preview (503). Verify hop order fix with ph-spear-2 public_case headers[0].hops[0].from == 'vps-77.hostingco.test' and pins persistence after reload.
